title: Enum Variant Visibility
goal: Pattern match on public enum variants across module boundaries.
hints: Public enums make all of their variants public automatically.
Variant names must match exact PascalCase capitalization.
explanation: Enum variants inherit the public visibility of their enum type. You do not write `pub` on individual variants. Writing lower-case variant names like `open` produces `E0532` because patterns are case-sensitive.
